words.name: technique-effects
words.spec: A technique's `effects` list may hold {"name": <library Effect name>, "unlock_layer": n, "passive_art": true, "rule": ...}. When a build knows the technique at layer n or above (fight.py `tech_layers`, export_combat_library.py, and GDScript FighterCompiler), the loader adds that Effect from assets/data/combat_effects.json and merges its counters. Matches Thiên Xu, Lạc Hà, Thủy Vị, and Phượng Minh's pending word of the same name.
words.gdd_text: Công Pháp rule (passive arts): a technique may carry passive arts, each a named Effect with an unlock layer. Known to that layer, the passive art's Effect is always on in a fight; it takes no art slot and is never fired.
words.decision_reason: Matches the unanimous batch b01 decision ('build' across thien_xu, lac_ha, thuy_vi, phuong_minh). Both Not a Drop Spilled and Return to the Scabbard are staged in effects/thinh_vu.effects.json with pending: technique-effects until the serial step wires technique.effects in both engines.

words.name: lint-requires-field
words.spec: Add "requires" to tools/design/arts/lint_arts.py FIELDS (already supported by fight.py root_gate, export_combat_library.py, and GDScript build_file_compiler.gd _root_gate using English engine element/variant ids against build.purity), then restore requires: {"root_lacks": ["thunder"]} on bronze-answers and requires: {"root_has": ["thunder"]} on the-chain-carries-it-down (and {"root_has": ["light"]} on phuong_minh's dawn-call).
words.gdd_text: Công Pháp lineage rule: a canon with an elemental or variant prerequisite may gate an art on what root the cultivator carries (requires.root_has / requires.root_lacks, English engine element/variant ids).
words.decision_reason: One-token lint_arts.py FIELDS addition in s6-serial-b01; both fight engines and export_combat_library.py already execute requires. Restoring requires with English 'thunder' (not Hán-Việt 'loi', which root_gate would silently fail to match) enforces thunder-in-the-rain-canon's Metal-vs-Thunder split for all 15 elders.
